newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sammi Corp defaults on promissory notes.
newsitem.headline: Sammi Corp defaults on promissory notes.

text.p: Sammi Corp has failed to honour 860.18 million won worth of promissory notes by the final deadline on Thursday, a company statement said.
The statement said all banks would freeze the company's chequing accounts from Friday.
Sammi Corp, an affiliate of Sammi Steel Co, has been in trouble under heavy debts.
The two companies, key units of South Korea's 26th-biggest conglomerate, the Sammi Group, on Tuesday filed for court protection from creditors.
Sammi Steel also defaulted on payments of promissory notes worth about 1.8 billion won by the deadline on Wednesday and all its checking accounts have been frozen.
